name: T-Shirts and Caps
headline: Custom T-Shirts and Caps for Teams, Staff, and Events
shortDescription: Custom T-shirt and cap graphics using heat transfer, inkjet transfer, or silk screen production methods.
body: T-shirts and caps can be produced using heat transfer, inkjet transfer, or silk screening depending on quantity, colours, and durability needs.
This service covers artwork placement, print method selection, garment graphics, and production preparation.
capabilities: T-shirt, cap, and promotional apparel layouts
